headline: Domino’s pays diners to beta test its relaunched website, app
summary: The pizza chain’s new campaign encourage consumers to leave feedback about its updated digital ordering experience.

headline: Domino's® is Paying Customers to Beta Test Its New Website and App
summary: Domino's Pizza Inc. (Nasdaq: DPZ) redesigned its website and app earlier this year to make it even better, but don't take our word for it. While other companies treat consumers like guinea pigs and ask them to test their sites and provide feedback for free, Domino's is paying customers to try its new digital ordering experience by giving them $5 off their next order.
